items.summary: Kalshi’s December 25-basis-point-hike heading fell from 72% to 69% and Polymarket’s separate row from 72% to 70% between October 30 page checks. A hike still leads; native quote times and causes are unknown.
December 25-basis-point-hike displays were 72% on both direct pages, five percentage points below the prior evening page checks. Native quote timing and cause are unknown.
December 25-basis-point-hike displays reached 77% on both direct pages, down three percentage points on Kalshi and one on Polymarket since the midday page checks. Quote times and cause are unknown.
December 25-basis-point-hike rows fell by one point on Kalshi and four points on Polymarket between page checks. BEA published GDP and PCE data, but quote-time and cause are unknown.

The FOMC held at 3.75%–4.00% by 10–2. The next scheduled meeting is December 8–9. Direct December event pages showed 81% and 82% for a 25-basis-point hike at about 19:05 UTC; no December repricing is established.

Kalshi October maintain Chance heading was 94%, unchanged from the prior evening check; Polymarket no-change named row was 93%, down two percentage points. Hold still leads before the 18:00 UTC statement; page access does not establish quote times or cause.

Kalshi maintain Chance heading remained 94%; Polymarket no-change named row reached 95%, one percentage point above the 13:35 UTC check. Hold still leads. Page checks do not establish quote timing or cause.

Kalshi maintain Chance heading and Polymarket no-change named row each showed 94% at about 13:35 UTC. Hold still leads; Kalshi is up one point since its 09:43 UTC page check and Polymarket is unchanged. Quote times and cause are unknown.

Kalshi maintain Chance heading 93% and Polymarket no-change row 94% at about 09:43 UTC. Hold remains the leading displayed outcome; neither page access time nor these checks establishes a quote-time path or cause.

October hold remains the leading named outcome: Kalshi maintain Chance heading 93% and Polymarket no-change row 95% at about 19:04 UTC. Up two and three percentage points since the October 23 evening page check; quote times and cause are unknown.

October hold remains the leading named outcome: Kalshi maintain Chance heading 91% and Polymarket no-change row 92% at about 19:03 UTC. Each is one point below the midday page check; quote times and cause are unknown. No October projections release is scheduled.

October hold still leads: Kalshi maintain Chance heading 92% and Polymarket no-change named row 93% at about 13:35 UTC. Each is two percentage points below the October 22 evening page check; quote times and cause are unknown.

October hold Chance heading reached 94% on Kalshi; Polymarket no-change named row reached 95% at about 19:06 UTC. Up five and four percentage points since midday page checks; intraday timing and cause are unknown.

October hold leads in direct page checks: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading 89%, Polymarket no-change named row 91%. Department of Labor weekly claims came between checks; quote times and price causes are unknown.
October hold remains the leading named outcome: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading 88%, Polymarket no-change row 87%. BLS earnings came between page checks; quote times and price causes are unknown.

Both October hold rows still lead: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading 89%, Polymarket no-change named row 88%. The BLS weekly earnings release was scheduled after the page checks; the small increases have no proven cause.

October hold still leads: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading 88%, Polymarket no-change named row 86% in the evening page checks. BLS released state employment data earlier; quote times and price causes are unknown.
Both October named hold readings were 87% at the page check, up one point on Kalshi and two on Polymarket since October 19 evening. Hold still leads; quote times and cause are unknown.
October hold remains the leading named outcome: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading 86%, Polymarket no-change row 85%. Small changes since the midday check; quote times and cause unknown.
Both named October hold readings were 86%, down one point from October 18 evening. Hold still led; venue quote times and cause were unavailable.

Both named October hold readings remained at 87% in evening page checks. Kalshi’s 25 bp-hike Chance heading fell two percentage points to 12%; Polymarket’s hike row remained at 14%. Venue quote times unavailable.
Both named October hold readings remained at 87% in midday page checks. Kalshi’s hike Chance heading rose one point to 14%; Polymarket’s hike row remained 14%. Quote times unavailable.

The two named October hold readings remained at 87% in direct page checks. Kalshi’s 25 bp-hike Chance heading eased one point to 13%; Polymarket’s named hike row remained 14%. Quote times unavailable.
Both October hold readings reached 87% in direct page checks, up 14–15 percentage points since October 15. Quote times and cause remain unknown.
Both October hold rows still led in evening page checks: Kalshi 72%, Polymarket 73%. Small opposing moves since midday; venue quote times and cause unknown.
October hold led on Kalshi and Polymarket page checks as BLS reported September PPI up 1.3%. Quote times were unavailable; no post-release price response is established.
Both October hold rows returned to 69% in evening page checks after a midday venue split. The Beige Book was published between checks; cause unproven.
After September CPI, Kalshi October hold fell to 53% but still narrowly led; Polymarket 25 bps hike rose to 52% and led its separate market. Cause unproven.
Kalshi’s October hold Chance heading rose to 82% and its hike heading fell to 19%; Polymarket named rows remained 80% and 20%. Hold still leads before CPI.
Kalshi October Chance headings moved to 81% maintain and 21% hike; Polymarket named rows held at 80% and 20%. Hold still leads before CPI.
Evening recheck: four named October event-contract rows were unchanged from about 19:11 UTC. Hold remains the leading outcome; CPI is next.

Both named October hold rows fell 4 percentage points to 80% since October 11. The Fed calendar correction removes a wrongly listed October 13 Economic Outlook speech; September CPI remains October 14.

October hold still leads: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading fell 1 point to 84%; Polymarket No change stayed 84% since the prior direct check. Waller speech, CPI and Beige Book are the next official checks; price causes unknown.
October hold still leads: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading remained 85%, its Hike 25bps heading fell 1 point to 15%, and Polymarket No change remained 84% since midday. Cause unknown.

October hold still leads. Kalshi’s named maintain-rate heading rose 2 percentage points since October 9 evening; Polymarket’s no-change row was unchanged. Next official test is September CPI on October 14.
Kalshi’s October maintain-rate Chance heading fell 2 points to 83% and Polymarket’s no-change row fell 1 point to 84% since midday. Both still lead; cause unknown.
Both named October hold rows reached 85% in direct page checks. Waller said additional hikes need not occur at consecutive meetings; no price cause is established.
Kalshi October maintain-rate Chance heading rose 1 point to 83% since midday; Polymarket No change stayed at 84%. Hold still leads, with no supported cause for the small move.
Kalshi October maintain-rate Chance heading fell 1 point to 82%; Polymarket No change stayed at 84%. Both still favor a hold, with no supported cause for the small changes.
After the September FOMC minutes, Kalshi October maintain-rate stayed at 83% and Polymarket No change rose 1 point to 84%. The minutes discuss another hike by year-end, not an October commitment.
Before the scheduled September FOMC minutes, Kalshi’s October hold heading rose 1 point to 83% since last evening; Polymarket No change stayed at 83%. Hold still led; cause unknown.
Named October hold rows rose 1 point to 82% on Kalshi and 83% on Polymarket since the afternoon check. Hold still led; cause unknown.
Named October hold rows rose 3 points to 81% on Kalshi and 82% on Polymarket since October 5 evening. Hold still led; cause unknown.
Named October hold rows fell 4 points to 78% on Kalshi and 79% on Polymarket since the afternoon check. Hold still led; the cause is unknown.
Kalshi’s October hold Chance heading fell 1 point to 82% since Sunday evening; Polymarket’s no-change row stayed at 83%. Hold still led, with no cause established.
Kalshi’s October hold heading rose 1 point to 83% since midday; Polymarket’s no-change row stayed at 83%. Hold still led, with no cause established.
Kalshi’s October hold heading fell 2 points to 82% since Saturday evening; Polymarket’s no-change row remained 83%. Hold still led on both pages; cause unknown.
Kalshi’s October hold heading rose 3 points to 84% since midday, while Polymarket’s no-change row remained 83%; both still led. The reason for the Kalshi move is unknown.
Kalshi’s named October hold heading showed 81% and Polymarket’s no-change row 83%; both still led after 1-point changes since October 2 evening. No cause established.
Both direct October hold rows showed 82%, down 2 points since the afternoon check; hold still led. The Fed calendar identifies October 7 minutes as the next scheduled policy record.
Named October hold rows rose to 84% on Kalshi and Polymarket, 9 points above the October 1 evening check. BLS September jobs data came between checks; cause unproven.
Named October hold rows rose to 75% on Kalshi (+10 points) and Polymarket (+11 points) since 13:36 UTC; Jefferson’s remarks and the move cannot be causally linked.
Hold/no change still led at 65% on Kalshi and 64% on Polymarket. Both named hold rows were unchanged since the prior evening; both named 25 bp-hike rows rose 2 points.
Hold/no change still led at 65% on Kalshi and 64% on Polymarket. Named rows changed by at most 2 points since midday; Williams’s conditional remarks do not establish a cause.
Hold/no-change leads extended to 65% on Kalshi and 66% on Polymarket. BEA published August PCE between checks; cause of the contract change is not established.
Hold overtook the named 25 bp-hike row on both direct October event pages between 13:35 and 19:02 UTC. August JOLTS was released between checks; cause is not established.
